author: Pedini
text:
Hiya C2C.

My apologies, I have only just noticed your post! I really appreciate your comment, comments like this mean a lot to me.

I just opened up my platform and by chance happened upon this nice level
 on AU. There was a strong push into it, which gave me confidence to
touch trade.

My entry was actually based on the orders in the far right arrow (not
very noticeable in this TF), but it was clear that if the level broke
(which it did) there would be sufficient orders just above which was
nearly guaranteed to bounce price. Its always nice to have a safety
blanket.

Peds

author: Chanya
text:
Pedini wrote: Something I caught on UJ today. Entry was off a lower TF after some nice wicks.

Hello Mr P, in your journal, u have many times used wicks as your
confirmation signal of PA when a specific level u have been looking for
is reached like the example above. I know wicks somehow signify the
presence of orders but on the other hand, doesnt wicks weakens the level
 and puts us in danger of consuming all orders that price instead of
reversing just breaks through ? Can u plz show me how u use this PA
(Wicks) for a confirmation of a reversal at a specific level ?

Regards

I really don't use them at all anymore
